create.name: Beth Bradford
create.bio:
Beth Bradford teaches yoga and meditation from Sussex County, Delaware, and writes about contemplative spirituality. She started out as a television news photojournalist in the Mid-Atlantic region, went on to earn a doctorate in mass communication at the University of Alabama, and spent around twenty years teaching media research, video production and journalism to university students. She is a registered yoga teacher with Yoga Alliance, a certified personal trainer and a long-time endurance athlete, and she shapes her work for people in midlife who want body, mind and spirit cared for together.

Her spiritual reading centres on the Christian contemplatives, from the Desert Fathers to Thomas Merton and the medieval mystics, which she sets beside yoga philosophy, Buddhist mindfulness, Sufi poetry and Stoic thought. On Insight Timer she shares guided meditations, short breathwork talks and prayer-based practices, along with a seven-day course on solitude drawn from her book Embracing Alone. Her YouTube channel mixes gentle and flowing yoga classes, pranayama and brief reflections on the inner life, and she writes the Substack newsletters The Contemplative Path and Steel & Sage. Near home she teaches private group yoga classes in people's houses or outdoors.

courses.title: Embracing Solitude
courses.description: A seven-day Insight Timer course on making friends with time alone: why it matters, how roles and distractions crowd out a truer sense of self, and how writing, movement and meditation can build a steady habit of solitude.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Group Yoga Class
courses.description: A private one-hour yoga class for a group of friends or family, shaped around what the group needs and booked online for a time that suits. Beth comes to you, at home or outdoors, in the Sussex County area.

free_resources.title: Beth Bradford on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations, short breathwork talks and video yoga practices, many of them rooted in Christian prayer and scripture, free to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: The Contemplative Path
free_resources.description: Beth's newsletter on contemplative spirituality, which reads the Desert Fathers, Merton and the Christian mystics alongside other traditions and asks what they mean for ordinary life today.
